subarea: FASTA launch then switch to Alignment
description: Load FASTA through Files, launch the network, switch to Alignment, and verify the sequence canvas renders.
primary_assertions: Global node and visible-link counts match the uploaded FASTA baseline; Alignment canvas renders; label rows equal the number of sequences; excluded-node count stays 0.
notes: This is the maintained FASTA smoke for Alignment on uploaded data.

subarea: Sequence node list launch then switch to Alignment
description: Load a node list with sequences, launch the network, switch to Alignment, and verify deterministic label-row rendering.
primary_assertions: Global counts stay coherent; Alignment canvas renders; label rows equal 14 sequence-bearing nodes; excluded-node count stays 0.
notes: This is the maintained uploaded node-list smoke for Alignment.

subarea: Node plus link launch with excluded missing-sequence nodes
description: Load uploaded node and distance-link files, switch to Alignment, and verify nodes lacking sequence data are omitted from the rendered alignment.
primary_assertions: Global counts match the uploaded SNP node+link baseline; Alignment canvas renders for 30 sequence-bearing nodes; excluded-node count shows 3; the Excluded Nodes dialog lists P1, P2, and P3.
notes: This covers the highest-value mixed file-type Alignment path on uploaded data.

file_types: node + distance link with partial sequence coverage
description: Open the Alignment Excluded Nodes dialog on uploaded data where some nodes have blank sequences.
primary_assertions: The toolbar counter shows 3; the dialog opens; the omitted node IDs are listed deterministically; the rendered label rows exclude those nodes.
notes: This is the maintained omission path for Alignment-specific sequence filtering.

description: Open Alignment settings and toggle the mini-map off and back on.
primary_assertions: #miniMapHolder hides and reappears through the real settings control; Alignment remains interactive after both transitions.
notes: Covered on uploaded data rather than only through the old sample-data spec.

description: Switch the Alignment top display from Bar Plot to Logo on uploaded data.
primary_assertions: The top-display title changes to Logo; the top SVG renders nucleotide logo glyph paths; Alignment remains interactive after the change.
notes: This covers the highest-value Alignment-specific settings path on maintained uploaded data.

description: Export the uploaded Alignment view as an SVG image.
primary_assertions: A non-empty SVG file is written to cypress/downloads; the file contains <svg markup from the rendered Alignment view.
notes: This is the maintained visual export path for Alignment.

description: Export the uploaded Alignment data as FASTA.
primary_assertions: A FASTA file is written to cypress/downloads; the file contains sequence headers and sequence content for the uploaded nodes.
notes: This covers the primary sequencing-data export path for Alignment.

description: Export the uploaded Alignment summary table as CSV.
primary_assertions: A non-empty CSV file is written to cypress/downloads; the header contains the expected position-based columns.
notes: This covers the advanced data-table export path exposed by the Alignment export dialog.

subarea: Direct file launch to Alignment default view
file_types: fasta; node with sequences; node + link with sequences
description: Set File Settings default view to Alignment View before launch and confirm the uploaded dataset reaches an interactive Alignment surface without hanging or rendering a broken canvas.
primary_assertions: The Processing Files dialog should clear; Alignment should be interactive immediately on launch; the rendered Alignment canvas should have non-zero size on the direct-launch path.
notes: Covered by the maintained direct-launch Alignment smoke across FASTA sequence-node and node+link fixtures after the direct-launch render-sync fix for ABG001.

subarea: Global search row highlight and autoscroll
description: Use the global search path while Alignment is active and verify matching rows highlight and scroll into view.
primary_assertions: Matching label rows gain the highlight class; the first match scrolls into view when needed; clearing the search removes the highlight.
notes: Covered with the maintained global-search exact-ID path on uploaded node+link Alignment data.

description: Switch Alignment to Amino Acids and then export data artifacts.
primary_assertions: Exported FASTA content reflects translated amino-acid sequences rather than nucleotide strings; sequence headers remain stable in AA mode; exported sequence-line lengths match the translated aa window.
notes: Covered by the maintained amino-acid FASTA export path on uploaded data.

subarea: Graceful handling for non-sequence file types
description: Launch or switch to Alignment from file types that do not carry sequence strings and verify the product handles them cleanly.
primary_assertions: The app should not hang or crash; Alignment should communicate that no sequence-bearing nodes are available, or the unsupported path should be blocked clearly.
notes: Covered with the maintained non-sequence empty-state path for uploaded edgelist-only matrix and Newick data after the unsupported-input runtime-error fix.

description: Change Start Position and End Position on uploaded data and verify the active Alignment window updates coherently.
primary_assertions: The displayed length text updates; the rendered canvas width changes with the active range; top ruler labels stay within the selected window; Alignment remains interactive after each range change.
notes: Covered by the maintained uploaded-data windowing journey.

description: Switch Sequence from Nucleotides to Codons on uploaded data.
primary_assertions: selectedSeqType updates to codon; codon spacing appears in the transformed sequence content; the view remains interactive and aligned after the conversion.
notes: Covered alongside the amino-acid branch in the maintained data-control spec.

subarea: Sequence type switch to Amino Acids
description: Switch Sequence from Nucleotides to Amino Acids on uploaded data.
primary_assertions: selectedSeqType updates to aa; the rendered Alignment switches to amino-acid mode; the length string reports nt-to-aa conversion; Alignment remains interactive.
notes: This is now covered in the maintained uploaded-data data-control suite.

file_types: uploaded sequence node list with gaps
description: While in Amino Acids mode, switch Translation Settings between Maintain Codons and Maintain Reading Frame.
primary_assertions: Rendered amino-acid sequences change on gapped codon inputs where expected; the selected translation mode persists; the view stays aligned after each change.
notes: Covered with a deterministic gapped 2-52 nt window on the uploaded AngularTesting node-list fixture.

description: Change Ruler Minor Interval, including 0, on uploaded data.
primary_assertions: Minor ruler tick labels update to the selected interval; interval 0 removes minor ticks; major ruler markings remain coherent.
notes: Covered in the maintained advanced-settings suite after the Alignment ruler dropdown began exposing the 0 branch reliably and the zero-interval assertions were restored.

description: Toggle Show Characters between Show, Minimum, and Hide on uploaded data.
primary_assertions: Canvas text rendering changes across Show, Minimum, and Hide; the show path draws the most text; minimum mode preserves reduced text rendering; Alignment remains interactive after each switch.
notes: Covered with canvas dark-pixel comparisons on uploaded node+link Alignment data.

description: Use the mini-map hover and click path on uploaded data to navigate to a new region in the alignment.
primary_assertions: The mini-map highlight appears and updates with pointer movement; clicking the mini-map updates canvasHolder, canvasLabels, and alignmentTop scroll positions coherently.
notes: Covered in the maintained uploaded-data interaction suite with mini-map highlight plus click-driven navigation assertions.

description: Hover a position in the Alignment top SVG and verify the per-position tooltip renders and hides correctly.
primary_assertions: The tooltip becomes visible on hover; it includes the hovered position and per-base proportions; it hides on mouseleave.
notes: Covered through the maintained per-position tooltip show/hide path on uploaded Alignment data.

description: Scroll the Alignment canvas on uploaded data and verify labels and top ruler stay synchronized.
primary_assertions: Horizontal canvas scroll updates alignmentTop scrollLeft; vertical canvas scroll updates canvasLabels scrollTop; the rows stay visually aligned with the rendered sequence canvas.
notes: Covered in the maintained interaction suite with explicit canvasScroll sync assertions after manual scroll changes.

file_types: uploaded sequence node list with multiple node fields
description: Change the Alignment Labels field on uploaded data.
primary_assertions: Label rows switch to the selected node field; row count stays stable; the backing alignView-labelField widget updates.
notes: Covered with the maintained Gender-label branch on uploaded sequence-node data.

file_types: uploaded sequence node list with categorical and numeric fields
description: Change Sort By on uploaded data across at least one numeric and one categorical field.
primary_assertions: Row order changes deterministically for both numeric and string sort paths; the rendered canvas stays aligned with the labels after sorting; the backing widget updates.
notes: Covered with Age then Subtype ordering assertions in the maintained uploaded-data settings suite.

description: Switch Size through Small, Medium, and Large on uploaded data.
primary_assertions: spanHeight, spanWidth, fontSize, and left label width update to the preset values; rendered canvas dimensions change accordingly.
notes: Covered through maintained Small, Medium, and Large preset assertions before the custom-size branch.

description: Set custom Height and Width values on uploaded data.
primary_assertions: The control switches to Custom size mode; spanHeight and spanWidth persist to widgets; rendered canvas and export-resolution text update accordingly.
notes: Covered in the maintained uploaded-data appearance suite.

description: Switch Color Scheme from Normal to Alternative on uploaded nucleotide data.
primary_assertions: Rendered canvas colors change to the alternative palette; the mini-map updates to the same palette; the backing color-scheme widget updates.
notes: Covered with canvas and mini-map pixel sampling on uploaded sequence-node data.

description: Switch Color Scheme to Custom and edit one or more nucleotide colors on uploaded data.
primary_assertions: Only the targeted nucleotide categories change to the edited colors in the canvas and mini-map; the custom color values persist in widgets.
notes: Covered with a maintained custom A-color branch on uploaded sequence-node data.

description: Switch into Amino Acids mode and verify Alignment uses the amino-acid palette instead of the nucleotide custom-color controls.
primary_assertions: The amino-acid palette is applied to the rendered canvas; nucleotide custom-color controls are not shown in AA mode.
notes: Covered after switching the maintained color-path suite into Amino Acids mode.

description: Export the uploaded Alignment view as a PNG image.
primary_assertions: A non-empty PNG file is written to cypress/downloads; the export resolution text is consistent with the current size settings.
notes: This now covers the image-export format counterpart to the maintained SVG path.

description: Export the uploaded Alignment data as a MEGA file.
primary_assertions: A .meg file is written to cypress/downloads; the file contains the expected MEGA header plus sequence identifiers and sequence data.
notes: Covered in the maintained uploaded-data export suite.

subarea: Consensus option on FASTA and MEGA exports
description: Enable Include Consensus for Alignment data exports and verify the consensus sequence is written.
primary_assertions: The exported FASTA and MEGA files contain a consensus entry in addition to the uploaded sequences; the consensus content is non-empty and correctly positioned.
notes: Covered by maintained consensus FASTA and consensus MEGA export assertions on uploaded data.

subarea: Consensus option on DataTable CSV export
description: Enable Include Consensus for Alignment DataTable export.
primary_assertions: The exported CSV includes consensus-related columns and non-empty consensus values when the option is enabled.
notes: Covered in the maintained uploaded-data export suite.

description: Select nodes elsewhere in the app, then switch to Alignment and verify the corresponding rows highlight and scroll into view.
primary_assertions: Selected Alignment label rows get the highlight class; the first selected row scrolls into view when needed; unrelated rows remain unhighlighted.
notes: Covered by maintained external session-selection assertions after document-level node-selected events.

description: Switch uploaded Alignment into Amino Acids mode and verify the top display can render the AA logo branch.
primary_assertions: selectedSeqType updates to aa; the top-display title switches to Logo; the top SVG renders amino-acid glyph classes from the translated data rather than only the nucleotide branch.
notes: Added after auditing the component and noticing the AA-specific top-render branch was not enumerated in the original tracker.

description: Switch uploaded Alignment into Amino Acids mode and verify the per-position tooltip uses AA content.
primary_assertions: The tooltip header shows AA mode; it lists amino-acid labels from the translated proportion matrix; it still hides cleanly on mouseleave.
notes: Added after auditing the AA-specific tooltip/tabulate branch that was not called out in the original tracker.

description: Switch uploaded Alignment into Amino Acids mode and export the translated data as MEGA.
primary_assertions: The exported .meg file contains the MEGA header; it declares DataType=Protein; translated sequence identifiers remain stable in AA mode.
notes: Added after auditing the AA-specific exportData branch that was not listed in the original tracker.

description: Switch uploaded Alignment into Amino Acids mode and export the consensus-enabled DataTable CSV.
primary_assertions: The exported CSV uses the amino-acid consensus header schema; the first row contains an AA consensus token; AA position columns are emitted instead of the nucleotide schema.
notes: Added after auditing the AA-specific exportDataTable consensus branch that was not listed in the original tracker.
